value.rationale: The regular octagon is a canonical polyhedral non-Hilbert Banach plane, and \(\Omega_X\) was introduced to quantify the gap between isosceles and Pythagorean behavior. An exact all-parameter profile is a natural benchmark, and the plateau plus two transition points expose geometric structure not supplied by a single endpoint or routine substitution. The result is self-contained, exact, and directly reusable when comparing geometric constants on polygonal norms.
